request.deadline: instantly performed as part of the governance action’s enactment on-chain
deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution of the treasury withdrawal to the intended recipient upon enactment
request.recipient: the Ikigai Info governance action submitter
request.what: Reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action, including claimed lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: An Info governance action titled “Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai -” was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork.
The Ikigai governance action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano’s future.
A Cardano node bug permitted use of an unregistered stake key in the governance action, causing the submitter to be unable to recover a 100,000 ADA deposit.
The proposal requests 103,000 ADA, consisting of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for claimed lost staking rewards at 2% per annum.
The proposer states there was significant community sentiment at the time that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in a budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The recipient of the reimbursement has not previously received funds from the treasury.
The requested withdrawal does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposer states no administrator custody, audits, oversight budget, costs, expenses, or refund circumstances apply because funds would be directly distributed on-chain.
The proposal references an AdaStat governance page for the related governance action.

summary: The proposal asks for 103,000 ADA to reimburse a claimed unrecoverable 100,000 ADA governance action deposit plus 3,000 ADA in claimed lost staking rewards, but most key facts are asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
